fields.name: schema_version
fields.notes: Required; reject unsupported major version.

fields.name: revision_id
fields.notes: Required immutable candidate identity.

fields.name: artifacts
fields.notes: Nonempty; unique scoped relative paths; each contains role, path, sha256 and byte_size; no traversal or phantom files.

fields.name: dependencies
fields.notes: Source, library, tool and rule identities plus digest/version; unknown version blocks reproducible release.

fields.name: manifest_sha256
fields.notes: Digest of canonical payload excluding this field; sorted artifact paths, stable JSON keys, UTF-8; timestamps excluded from identity.

fields.name: intent_revision
fields.notes: Desired behavior owned by approved requirements; not inferred from native edits.

fields.name: native_manifest_sha256
fields.notes: Current implementation identity; never silently replaced by intent.

fields.name: circuit
fields.notes: Stable component/pin/net IDs, explicit isolated and NC nodes, functional block applicability and evidence refs.

fields.name: presentation
fields.notes: Circuit revision ref, sheets, poses, wire/label geometry and human locks; no topology authority.

fields.name: layout_constraints
fields.notes: Board-class ID, explicit units/frame, outline/stackup/keepout/fixed connectors and provenance.

fields.name: reconciliation
fields.notes: Any unaccepted intent/native divergence prevents release.

fields.name: subject_manifest_sha256
fields.notes: Required exact examined subject; never a live substitute for delivered files.

fields.name: execution
fields.notes: Tool execution, independent of engineering verdict.

fields.name: verdict
fields.notes: Pass requires succeeded execution and complete nonempty applicable examination; not-applicable requires explicit applicability evidence.

fields.name: coverage
fields.notes: Required expected_ids, examined_ids, omitted[{id,reason}]; examined subset of expected; omitted exactly expected minus examined. Empty expected requires applicability proof, otherwise indeterminate.

fields.name: tool_rule_dependencies
fields.notes: Required versions/digests and source anchors; all compared at release.

fields.name: axis
fields.notes: Form success never substitutes for electrical validation.

fields.name: findings
fields.notes: Stable codes and source/object anchors; empty list is not pass evidence.

fields.name: raw_result_ref
fields.notes: Preserve raw output when executed; null allowed only with explicit absence reason.

fields.name: reason
fields.notes: Required for failed execution, not-run, indeterminate or not-applicable.

fields.name: freshness
fields.notes: Derived by dependency comparison, not caller assertion; stale/unknown blocks release.

fields.name: baseline_manifest_sha256
fields.notes: Required compare-and-apply precondition.

fields.name: supported_edit_classes
fields.notes: Explicit versioned allowlist; initial schematic pose support does not imply PCB or arbitrary rotation support.

fields.name: operations
fields.notes: Stable target IDs, before/after values, evidence refs and affected checks; unsupported operation refuses the batch.

fields.name: locked_object_ids
fields.notes: Cannot change without separately recorded explicit unlock.

fields.name: approval_ref
fields.notes: Exact proposal approval; not manufacturing approval.

fields.name: conflicts
fields.notes: Nonempty stops before writes; baseline check and apply must share a concurrency guard.

fields.name: manifest_sha256
fields.notes: Exact release including board, exports, BOM and library manifest.

fields.name: decision
fields.notes: Human-issued, never set by generator/checker.

fields.name: actor
fields.notes: Authenticated approval identity supplied by approved caller boundary.

fields.name: recorded_at
fields.notes: Timestamp of explicit decision; not a substitute for freshness.

fields.name: required_checks
fields.notes: Versioned release-policy check IDs; explicit justified not-applicable may satisfy applicability, not a missing check.

fields.name: source
fields.notes: Required upstream URL, commit, relevant paths and evidence kind: source/test-source/document-claim; execution evidence separate.

fields.name: license
fields.notes: Observed grant, notice paths, compatibility review and approval; unknown blocks extraction.

fields.name: integration
fields.notes: Named owning package, supported capability/version and unmeasured limits; does not imply installed dependency.

fields.name: board_manifest_sha256
fields.notes: Exact native board and exported STEP source identity.

fields.name: enclosure_manifest_sha256
fields.notes: Exact candidate enclosure identity; part of combined verification subject.

fields.name: frame
fields.notes: Required mm units, right-handed axes, origin, board normal and rigid board_to_enclosure 4x4 matrix; reject reflection/scale/nonfinite transform.

fields.name: models
fields.notes: Stable object IDs, solid artifact hash, provenance, expected shape/height/service envelope; missing models listed, not invented.

fields.name: fixed_constraints
fields.notes: Outline, holes, connector poses and mating envelopes; each bound to source revision and frame.

fields.name: schema_version
fields.notes: bodesign-owned contract; not the upstream AGPL schema.

fields.name: source_manifest_sha256
fields.notes: Pinned bridge/input identity and backend capability revision.

fields.name: nodes
fields.notes: Unique stable id, operation enum enclosure|boss|cutout, depends_on IDs, typed parameters with units, anchor refs, constraints and evidence. Nonempty DAG; reject cycles, dangling refs, unknown operations.

fields.name: anchors
fields.notes: Object ID, semantic role, source revision, geometric predicate, tolerance and cardinality=1. Never accept arbitrary first face or stale topology index.

fields.name: execution
fields.notes: Deterministic topological ordering with stable ID tie-break; isolated candidate document; per-node receipt and output revision. No LLM during compile.

fields.name: subject_manifest_sha256
fields.notes: Combined board/enclosure/transform/model/rule identities; wraps VerificationRecord axis mechanical.

fields.name: method
fields.notes: AABB alone cannot satisfy exact mechanical release policy.

fields.name: pairs
fields.notes: Expected and examined stable object pairs, omission reasons, collision volume and min distance when computed; absence is null with reason, never zero.

fields.name: policy
fields.notes: Required physical clearance per pair, declared contacts, numerical tolerance and geometry backend/version. Undefined tolerance or clearance yields indeterminate.

fields.name: coverage
fields.notes: Expected model IDs, available validated solids and missing IDs; no proxy solid silently promoted to authoritative geometry.

fields.name: model
fields.notes: Formula identifier/version and topology applicability evidence; RC cutoff, crystal effective capacitance or applicable feedback voltage.

fields.name: inputs
fields.notes: Each numeric value has unit, conditions, source and uncertainty/assumption status; no default stray capacitance, Vref or heuristic load current as verified input.

fields.name: result
fields.notes: Computed value and limitations; absent prerequisites return null plus gap list, not a plausible nominal value.

fields.name: request_id
fields.notes: Stable dedup identity, bound to immutable payload digest; same ID/different payload refused.

fields.name: baseline_revision
fields.notes: Native/cloud immutable revision plus write precondition. Unsupported atomic precondition means read-only until explicit serialization is proved.

fields.name: capability_revision
fields.notes: Vendor/tool version and supported operations; credential reference only, no secret in payload/log.

fields.name: state
fields.notes: Pending cancellation is side-effect-free; running timeout maps to unknown until authoritative read-back; no blind retries or rollback claim.

fields.name: receipt
fields.notes: Node results, resulting revision and side effects. Unknown jobs map A2 indeterminate and block publication.

fields.name: schema_version
fields.notes: Versioned original contract; reject unsupported major versions.

fields.name: source
fields.notes: Explicit selection, not a fallback chain. Supplied human baseline cannot be bypassed.

fields.name: native_sheet_hashes
fields.notes: Complete root and leaves: scoped path, SHA256, byte size, native version. Dependencies and sheet references resolved before mutation.

fields.name: pinned_object_ids
fields.notes: Scoped sheet/instance/UUID identities; human mode protects all pre-existing presentation objects, not only this explicit subset.

fields.name: baseline_manifest_sha256
fields.notes: P1 ArtifactManifest binding exact native bytes and library dependencies.

fields.name: declared_circuit_revision
fields.notes: Separate topology authority; differences produce ChangeProposal, never silent reconciliation.

fields.name: engine_ref
fields.notes: Engine mode pins version, package integrity, license/notice clearance and layout options; human/legacy modes explicitly null.

fields.name: edit_policy
fields.notes: Inspect/derive default. Explicit supported edit classes, approved ChangeProposal and before-write baseline guard for candidate-only edits. Preserve untouched byte spans; unsupported syntax refuses.

fields.name: subject_manifest_sha256
fields.notes: P1 binding of exact native sheet set, exported netlist and native SVG/raster artifacts.

fields.name: presentation_baseline_ref
fields.notes: Baseline identity; evidence cannot be reused after presentation changes.

fields.name: render_context
fields.notes: Renderer/version, artifact hashes, viewBox-to-mm transform, viewing scale, stroke and text metrics. Missing mapping is indeterminate.

fields.name: policy_ref
fields.notes: Version/digest, calibrated tolerances, local-net K and explicit applicability rules. Page-use 50% is not a universal default.

fields.name: classes
fields.notes: Exactly a-f: junction ambiguity; contact/crossing ambiguity; local wired-path completeness; series-path legibility; foreign-net corridors; text/scale/page use. Each includes expected_ids, examined_ids, omitted with reasons, applicability, measurements, verdict and localized native-ID/render-region findings. Separate actual electrical error from perceptual ambiguity.

fields.name: calibration_ref
fields.notes: Pinned CP1-CP3 rejection matrix plus reviewed accepting/corrected cases, per-class confusion/coverage, missing assets and policy version; no generic always-NO acceptance.

fields.name: execution
fields.notes: Independent of form verdict and calibration state.

fields.name: verdict
fields.notes: Unknown/uncalibrated required classes cannot pass; N/A requires explicit applicability evidence.

fields.name: human_review_ref
fields.notes: Independent final reviewer decision bound to exact artifacts; instrument pass alone is not delivery acceptance.

fields.name: does_not_authorize
fields.notes: Must include electrical_correctness, fidelity and manufacturing_release. Wrap as VerificationRecord axis=form with raw evidence retained.

fields.name: module
fields.notes: Matches IDEF0 and outcome table.

fields.name: outcome
fields.notes: Closed domain; unknown values rejected, never defaulted to success.

fields.name: code
fields.notes: Typed error/gap code when not ok.

fields.name: subject_ref
fields.notes: Manifest identity if available; absent before ingest is explicit.

fields.name: details
fields.notes: Gap list, coverage or conflict records; raw native results preserved.
